description: A fact only the knowledge graph holds reaches plan's prompt through the seed linker
notes: The one task that exercises the graph path end to end. The seed writes a :Concept whose id the deployed linker can produce — `langgraph`, an id from a live extraction (tool-use-001.trial-0.json) — and a graphFacts entry that MENTIONS it and exists nowhere in pgvector, beside one ordinary pgvector fact. The question names the concept capitalized, so retrieveNode's linker yields ["what", "langgraph"] and expandFromSeeds reaches the graph fact at distance 1. retrieved_from_source passes only on a candidate whose source is neo4j, and rrfMerge reports a fact both retrievers found as pgvector, so a pass means the graph alone put the fact in plan's prompt. That is all it proves: it says nothing about whether the graph improves retrieval in general, which is P2-B's ablation. The seed hashes are labels rather than sha256 of the text, as in the other tasks, so a fact reflect writes with the same wording cannot collide with a seed and survive the reset. maxSteps is 1 so a recording costs three generateContent calls: plan, selectTool and the extraction.
